title: ItipInteraction
description: ITIP base Archetype for Interaction — the single GSM primitive relation, Effector to Receptor. Inherits gsm/Interaction through the top-level $ref and composes the ITIP-wide ItipAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Interaction statement distributed in an ITIP framework MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Interaction, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).
